name: Sex of Thrones 2 👑
source: Sex of Thrones 2 takes you to the frozen North, where ice creatures threaten the kingdom. Use seduction, power, and strategy to survive. Form alliances, conquer new lovers, and shape the fate of the realm in this immersive, adult visual novel.
translation: 《权力的性别2》将带你前往冰天雪地的北方，那里的冰雪生物威胁着王国。利用诱惑、权力和策略来生存。在这部身临其境的成人视觉小说中结成联盟，征服新恋人，并塑造王国的命运。
